headline: Mistral releases Voxtral 3 speech models and a real-time voice-agent SDK
summary: Mistral announced Voxtral 3 on 2026-10-20: speech transcription and synthesis models plus a voice-agent SDK combining streaming audio input, an interchangeable reasoning model, tool calls and speech output. The release is available through Mistral APIs; private-cloud or on-premises deployment is offered by contacting Mistral. The company reports sub-second end-to-end turns and multilingual model results, but these performance claims have not been independently verified.
